text: the tree trunk looks horrible. that was like half the battle of doing all the isolated work before just shitting it in. so its non negotiable also, they all just disappeared, so whats the reason why you didnt port the trunk
resolution: Ported the REAL PalmTrunk geometry into the compiled game, replacing the placeholder cylinder (committed dbac45e3f). buildPalmTrunk() in world_loader.zig is the compiled twin of runtime/geometries/PalmTrunk.ts — tapered base→top, low bulge, scar-ring radius ripple, forward lean (28 seg × 10 sides, per-vertex outward normals); INSTANCE_SHAPE_PALMTRUNK=9 + its own lit-mesh batch/stream proto. palmPopulation emits trunks base-origin (y=ground) scaling x/z by radius/0.13 so the baked shape holds (tree_probe's span math). Cutting this for a cylinder was a bad shortcut; the trunk quality was the point of the prior isolated work.
